title: RE: Custom Swim Spa Cover
description:
Is this spa in the middle of a remodel? Do you plan to add new coping to the top of the spa?

 

Chris

 

From: Esther Scott <esther.evelyn@gmail.com> 
Sent: Sunday, September 13, 2026 10:30 AM
To: support@spacoversetc.com
Subject: Custom Swim Spa Cover

 

Hi,

I'm looking for a quote on a custom insulated cover for a DIY-built pool. There's no manufacturer model to reference, so here are the specs:

DIMENSIONS

*	Outside edge to outside edge: 155" x 101"
*	Water opening: 140" x 83.5"
*	Corners: square
*	Note the wide lip: 7.5" at each end, 8.75" at each side. This is intentional, not a typo.

USE CONDITIONS

*	Heated to 100–105°F in spring and fall only (roughly March–May and September–November). Unheated through the summer.
*	Located in Arlington, VA (zip 22205) — snow load and freeze/thaw are in play at the shoulders of the season.
*	Because of the temperature and surface area, believe we need a closed-cell foam core (iXPE/XPE or similar). Don't want an EPS core that can waterlog.

SITE GEOMETRY — this is the unusual part

*	The far short end has a 22" wall above grade.
*	The near short end sits flush with the ground.
*	The two long sides slope between the two, so edge height varies continuously from 0" to 22".
*	Because of that varying height, a conventional uniform vinyl skirt won't work. I'd rather have no skirt at all, but I'm open to a partial or contoured one if you have a good approach.
*	We can hold the edges down on 3 sides

title: Reservation Reminder for East Potomac Golf Links - WHITE Course
description: 96 Confirmation# 429975100 Hi Esther Scott , Your reservation is tomorrow at 8:30 am. East Potomac Golf Links - WHITE Course Saturday, September 19, 2026 8:30 am 4 Player(s) A Note from National Links Trust: We are devastated to share that the Trump administration has terminated National Links Trust’s lease, effective immediately. In the short term, NLT has agreed to stay on as operators, allowing our courses to remain open and our hundreds of dedicated employees to stay in place. However, the future of affordable, accessible, high-quality public golf in the District is bleak. This is not the update we wanted to share. As a DC golfer, you know how special the East Potomac, Langston, and Rock Creek courses are. While this termination is a major setback, we remain stubbornly hopeful that a path forward can be found that preserves affordable and accessible public golf in the nation’s capital for generations to come. PlayDCgolf and NLT remain fully committed to honoring the legacies and principles of DC’s historic public courses. We hope that you stand with us and continue to share your love of DC public golf with friends, family, and beyond. Tee Time Cancellation Policy: Please log into the tee time booking portal at least 2 hours in advance to cancel or reduce the number of players to your tee time. Questions about your reservation? title: Re: Capital One: what is management not saying?
description:
Esther - you know the real story. You actually worked at Capital One.

Every earnings call, management explains what the quarter means. Once you join our panel, we'll ask you how what they say matches with what you saw.

We'll ask you questions that are tailored to you based on your prior roles, and your answers will make sure the right story is being told.

Question examples include:

 * Management explains why something happened. You know whether that's how it actually works. 
   
   
 * A metric went up. You know what's actually inside it, and whether it proves what they're claiming. 
   
   
 * They've promised something by a date. You know where the real bottleneck is, and how long it takes. 
   
   
 * The key numbers to watch, and what they mean when they change.


In return is not only compensation but also the final report itself (plus those for related companies).
